scope: CMDB data health, CSDM service modelling, relationship quality and governance

criteria.question: What proportion of in-scope CIs have every required identity attribute populated?
criteria.measure: CIs passing required-field rules ÷ eligible in-scope CIs, by class
criteria.evidence: CMDB Health Completeness, configured required fields and inclusion rules
criteria.remediation: Repair missing required attributes; correct class rules and feeds.

criteria.question: What proportion of in-scope CIs have the recommended operational attributes populated?
criteria.measure: CIs passing recommended-field rules ÷ eligible in-scope CIs, by class
criteria.evidence: CMDB Health recommended-fields metric; class-scoped sampled records
criteria.remediation: Define fit-for-purpose field rules and fill high-value gaps.

criteria.question: What is the duplicate CI rate for independently identified CI classes in scope?
criteria.measure: Duplicate independent CIs ÷ eligible independent CIs
criteria.evidence: CMDB Health Correctness duplicate metric, identification rules
criteria.remediation: Investigate identification rules, data-source overlaps and duplicate-remediation tasks.

criteria.question: What is the stale CI rate under appropriate, class-specific freshness rules?
criteria.measure: Stale in-scope CIs ÷ eligible in-scope CIs, with rule and period stated
criteria.evidence: CMDB Health staleness scorecards, class-specific rules
criteria.remediation: Review collection schedules, staleness policies and retirement.

criteria.question: What is the orphan CI rate under the approved class-specific orphan rules?
criteria.measure: Orphan CIs ÷ eligible CIs, by class and rule
criteria.evidence: CMDB Health orphan metric; actual configured orphan rules
criteria.remediation: Correct missing dependencies or attributes; retire obsolete records.

criteria.question: Do relevant CIs pass configured CMDB compliance audits against defined organisational requirements?
criteria.measure: CIs passing relevant current audits ÷ CIs evaluated, disclose audit coverage
criteria.evidence: CMDB Health compliance audits; audit run date and rule scope
criteria.remediation: Enable/fix applicable audits and address repeated failures.

criteria.question: Are in-scope business applications, application services and technical CIs classified in the correct CSDM roles/classes?
criteria.measure: Expert-reviewed correctly classified records ÷ sample reviewed
criteria.evidence: CSDM Data Foundations stage reports and sampled class review
criteria.remediation: Reclassify wrongly modelled records and update modelling standards.

criteria.question: Are critical application services represented and linked to their technical components?
criteria.measure: Critical application services with validated technical support map ÷ in-scope critical application services
criteria.evidence: CSDM dashboards and service-map review
criteria.remediation: Populate missing application services and supporting-CI relationships.

criteria.question: Are business services or offerings related to the correct application services where the use case requires those links?
criteria.measure: Required service-to-application links confirmed ÷ expected links in sampled critical services
criteria.evidence: CSDM Run-stage indicators and owner-verified service mappings
criteria.remediation: Link the service model to the application service layer.

criteria.question: Can selected business critical services be traced to the relevant technical dependencies?
criteria.measure: Representative critical service topology paths can be traced to supporting technical CI records
criteria.evidence: CMDB relationship views, service maps or sampled topology traversal results
criteria.remediation: Resolve missing service model nodes and wrong dependency edges.

criteria.question: Are the CSDM Data Foundations findings relevant to the chosen use case reviewed and assigned remediation owners?
criteria.measure: Applicable high-priority findings with accepted dispositions ÷ relevant high-priority findings
criteria.evidence: CSDM Data Foundations report, improvement backlog and ownership
criteria.remediation: Triage model gaps, designate owners and evidence closure.

criteria.question: What proportion of expected dependencies for selected important services is represented in the CMDB?
criteria.measure: Verified expected dependencies recorded ÷ total expected dependencies in sampled services
criteria.evidence: Service topology sample and independently reviewed dependency inventory
criteria.remediation: Map missing dependencies, focusing on critical service paths.

criteria.question: Are relationship types and directions correct for the selected service dependency paths?
criteria.measure: Correctly directed and typed sampled dependencies ÷ sampled dependencies
criteria.evidence: Relationship type rules and representative dependency traversal evidence
criteria.remediation: Correct parent/child direction and relationship semantics; rerun traversal.

criteria.question: What percentage of in-scope CI relationships are duplicates?
criteria.measure: Duplicate relationships ÷ relationships in assessment scope
criteria.evidence: CMDB Relationship Health duplicate metric
criteria.remediation: Deduplicate invalid relationships; fix ingest rules.

criteria.question: What percentage of in-scope relationships are orphaned?
criteria.measure: Orphan relationships ÷ relationships in scope
criteria.evidence: CMDB Relationship Health orphan metric
criteria.remediation: Repair broken endpoints or clean up invalid links.

criteria.question: What percentage of in-scope relationships are stale because a connected CI is stale?
criteria.measure: Stale relationships ÷ relationships in scope
criteria.evidence: CMDB Relationship Health stale metric
criteria.remediation: Repair the source CI freshness issue and recheck its links.

criteria.question: Do relevant relationships comply with configured suggested, hosting and containment rules?
criteria.measure: Compliant applicable links ÷ links tested; identify exclusions
criteria.evidence: CMDB Relationship Health rule conformance summaries
criteria.remediation: Correct invalid relationship types and class modelling.

criteria.question: Do representative service topology traversals return the expected upstream and downstream paths?
criteria.measure: Expected traversal paths correctly represented ÷ reference traversal scenarios tested
criteria.evidence: Tested topology diagrams for important services, including expected and actual paths
criteria.remediation: Repair missing/wrong service paths and retest affected scenarios.

criteria.question: What proportion of in-scope CIs and services has an active, accountable operational owner?
criteria.measure: Records with valid active accountable owner ÷ eligible CI/service records
criteria.evidence: CMDB ownership attributes, team references, sampled attestation
criteria.remediation: Assign accountable owners and remove inactive/stale references.

criteria.question: Are authoritative data sources and attribute-level reconciliation responsibilities defined for critical CI classes?
criteria.measure: Relevant classes/attributes with defined source authority ÷ relevant set
criteria.evidence: IRE reconciliation and source-rule review; source catalogue
criteria.remediation: Define data authority and reconcile conflicting updates.

criteria.question: Do CI identification rules uniquely identify records entering the in-scope CMDB classes?
criteria.measure: Positive and collision tests passed ÷ defined IRE test cases
criteria.evidence: Identification rule configuration and duplicate simulation results
criteria.remediation: Adjust identification precedence and validate multiple-source cases.

criteria.question: Are critical CI/service records periodically certified or reviewed by accountable owners?
criteria.measure: Due reviews completed and valid ÷ due reviews in defined period
criteria.evidence: Certification/audit tasks, attestation dates, sampled reviews
criteria.remediation: Introduce risk-based attestation and review cadence.

criteria.question: Are CMDB Health jobs, remediation activities and periodic trend reviews operating for the relevant classes and rules?
criteria.measure: Controls operating and evidenced, 0–4 maturity anchors
criteria.evidence: Enabled health jobs, health-history reports, remediation backlog and closure verification
criteria.remediation: Activate the appropriate jobs; assign health findings and monitor recurring errors.

SN-M.name: ServiceNow CMDB Health KPIs and metrics

sourceNote: Independent, source informed assessment. The score, criteria, maturity bands and weights are authored for this research preview. They are not a ServiceNow CMDB Health Dashboard result or official maturity certification.
